candidate_workaround: Split syntax compilation and Git-state inspection into separate bounded probes, crediting each only after its own successful result.
failure_signature: A combined syntax-compilation and Git-status wrapper exceeded its 30-second bound without returning a result.
recurrence_guard: Do not combine Python compilation and broad Windows Git status in one short wrapper; use separate bounds and outputs.
rollback: Stop, retain the failed wrapper, and leave repository history and external state unchanged.
title: Bounded recovery for combined_syntax_status_wrapper_timeout
